paragraphs.source_en: The first month I racked up about $300 or so. When the bill came, there was each charge listed by vendor, with the total at the bottom. paragraphs.source_en: I could hardly believe my eyes. I get to buy $300 worth of stuff and they only require me to pay them back $10 a month? And I can still buy more? Wow! This is awesome!
